status: prior - class defaults, NOT tuned on light_rocket_v2_pack_forward
provenance: control/controller.py CascadedPID attribute defaults (z-axis multirotor era). Ki_vel prior 0.15 = research/tune_gains.py CPID_BASE kiV_h (different CPID structure, prior only); added 2026-09-25 by kj decision (conditional velocity integral, paper sec 5.3).
heading: from_plant_hover_convention
role: Low-speed practical baseline, design region 0-20 m/s (configs/arena.json controllers.CPID.design_region_m_s). Excluded from main-test scenarios that go above the region (kj decision 2026-09-26); the high-speed limit of linear fixed-gain control is GSLQR's role.
design_note: Tilt limit is measured from world vertical. The trim thrust axis is 33.4 deg (controller model) / 34.1 deg (plant) from vertical at 20 m/s and 45.1 deg at 25 m/s, so with the PX4 default 45 deg the design region 0-20 m/s keeps ~11 deg of margin. No aero feed-forward: the integrators carry the aerodynamic share of the trim (20 m/s: 4.63 m/s^2 horizontal, 2.85 m/s^2 vertical), so the arena preloads them from the controller-model trim (configs/arena.json controllers.CPID.integrator_preload).
integrator_note: Both integrators (horizontal velocity, altitude) are limited as ACCELERATION AUTHORITY in m/s^2 (1 g), independent of Ki, and are frozen while the command is tilt- or rotor-limited (paper sec 5.3 conditional integration). PX4 PositionControl limits only the VERTICAL velocity integral to +-1 g (CONSTANTS_ONE_G) and uses tracking anti-windup with no fixed magnitude in the horizontal plane; the horizontal +-1 g here extends PX4's vertical criterion to the horizontal plane. It never binds inside the design region (design check: limit -> infinity is bit-identical). a_int_z_max=null restores the legacy altitude integrator (unconditional, state limit int_z_max in m*s = 2.5 m/s^2 at Ki_z 0.5).
change_record: 2026-09-26 kj decision: velocity integral limit 5 -> 9.81 m/s^2, altitude integral legacy -> 9.81 m/s^2 conditional, plus integrator preload. 2026-09-26 kj decision: max_tilt_deg 35 -> 45 = PX4 default MPC_TILTMAX_AIR (checked in PX4 main, src/modules/mc_pos_control/multicopter_position_control_limits_params.yaml: default 45.0) because the manuscript describes CPID as the PX4 structure and the 20 m/s trim (33.4 deg) sat at the edge of 35 deg; class default stays 35 (legacy bit-identical). All of these were made AFTER seeing results, OUTSIDE the tuning budget, in CPID's FAVOUR (baseline-strengthening). Recorded in the fairness table of results/ARENA_STATUS.
